title: Replaceable elf 0.8 exec loader
summary: Replace production goblin parsing with a tx-owned ElfFileParser backed by elf 0.8.0, staged metadata reads, platform policy, and validated dynamic interpreter layout. Non-goals are dynamic tag/symbol/hash/relocation processing, vDSO implementation owned by the vDSO plan, and uncoordinated PageBacked executable-lease edits.

write_sets.notes: Parser trait, elf 0.8 backend, tx-owned facts, policy and loader tests. Staged exec integration is coordinated separately with the active vDSO plan.

steps.title: Add tx-owned ELF values and replaceable parser trait
steps.notes: TDD starts with the trait contract test.

steps.title: Implement elf 0.8 syntax decoder
steps.notes: Use elf low-level header and ParsingTable APIs; no elf type escapes.

steps.title: Build image plans from parser-independent platform policy
steps.notes: Covers target ISA, checked file/final VA ranges, entry and PHDR validation.

steps.title: Retain TLS, dynamic, RELRO and GNU stack facts
steps.notes: No kernel dynamic linker is introduced.

steps.title: Integrate bounded header, phdr and interpreter reads
steps.notes: Coordinate line ownership with vdso-migration before editing script.rs.

steps.title: Validate combined main/interpreter layout and auxv
steps.notes: Preserve any vDSO mappings and AT_SYSINFO_EHDR work that lands first.

steps.title: Remove goblin and close core guest verification
verification: RV64 and LA64 static, PIE, musl and glibc exec witnesses
steps.notes: Complete-program status remains open for executable lease, yielding StepOp, and vDSO GNU-stack closure.

risks: Current exec files contain unrelated uncommitted StepOp migration changes that must be preserved.
The active vDSO plan owns overlapping future exec and VM paths.
Changing strict alignment/WX behavior can invalidate hand-built fixtures while improving Linux compatibility.
Production parser replacement does not by itself provide ETXTBSY generation stability or a yielding exec continuation.
blockers: Final NX GNU-stack enforcement depends on vDSO migration phase 6.
Progress validation is currently blocked by the pre-existing vdso-migration status value 'in_progress'.
